changelog:
Initial release of codesys-toolkit.

- Automates CODESYS/InoProShop PLC programming, supporting project generation, POU export/patching, compilation, device enumeration, and error dialog monitoring.
- Provides PowerShell and IronPython tools for environment setup, process automation, and code management.
- Supports incremental patching for POU files to minimize unnecessary overwrites.
- Includes detailed documentation for configuration, workflow, error handling, and supported PLC models.
- Designed for use with InoProShop V1.9.0.1+ (with CODESYS Scripting API), PowerShell 5.1+, IronPython 2.7, on Windows 10/11.
